verses.en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR, ouve minha oração; e que meu clamor chegue a ti.
verses.en_web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
verses.en_bbe: <A Prayer of the man who is in trouble, when he is overcome, and puts his grief before the Lord.> Give ear to my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come to you.

verses.en: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.pt: Não escondas de mim o teu rosto no dia da minha angústia; inclina a mim teu ouvidos; no dia em que eu clamar, apressa-te para me responder.
verses.en_web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
verses.en_bbe: Let not your face be veiled from me in the day of my trouble; give ear to me, and let my cry be answered quickly.

verses.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.pt: Porque os meus dias têm se desfeito como fumaça; e meus ossos se têm se queimado como n um forno.
verses.en_web: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
verses.en_bbe: My days are wasted like smoke, and my bones are burned up as in a fire.

verses.en: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.pt: Meu coração, tal como a erva, está tão ferido e seco, que me esqueci de comer meu pão.
verses.en_web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
verses.en_bbe: My heart is broken; it has become dry and dead like grass, so that I give no thought to food.

verses.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.pt: Por causa da voz do meu gemido, meus ossos têm se grudado à minha carne.
verses.en_web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the voice of my sorrow, my flesh is wasted to the bone.

verses.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.pt: Estou semelhante a uma ave no deserto, estou como uma coruja num lugar desabitado.
verses.en_web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
verses.en_bbe: I am like a bird living by itself in the waste places; like the night-bird in a waste of sand.

verses.en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.pt: Fico alerta e estou como um pardal solitário sobre o telhado.
verses.en_web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
verses.en_bbe: I keep watch like a bird by itself on the house-top.

verses.en: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.pt: Os meus inimigos me insultam o dia todo; os que me odeiam juram maldições contra mim.
verses.en_web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
verses.en_bbe: My haters say evil of me all day; those who are violent against me make use of my name as a curse.

verses.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.pt: Porque estou comendo cinza como se fosse pão, e misturo minha bebida com lágrimas,
verses.en_web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
verses.en_bbe: I have had dust for bread and my drink has been mixed with weeping:

verses.en: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.pt: Por causa de tua irritação e tua ira; porque tu me levantaste e me derrubaste.
verses.en_web: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.
verses.en_bbe: Because of your passion and your wrath, for I have been lifted up and then made low by you.

verses.en: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.pt: Meus dias têm sido como a sombra, que declina; e eu estou secando como a erva.
verses.en_web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
verses.en_bbe: My days are like a shade which is stretched out; I am dry like the grass.

verses.en: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.pt: Porém tu, SENHOR, permaneces para sempre; e tua lembrança continua geração após geração.
verses.en_web: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
verses.en_bbe: But you, O Lord, are eternal; and your name will never come to an end.

verses.en: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.pt: Tu te levantarás, e terás piedade de Sião; porque chegou o tempo determinado para se apiedar dela.
verses.en_web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
verses.en_bbe: You will again get up and have mercy on Zion: for the time has come for her to be comforted.

verses.en: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.pt: Pois os teus servos se agradam de suas pedras, e sentem compaixão do pó de suas ruínas.
verses.en_web: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
verses.en_bbe: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, looking with love on her dust.

verses.en: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.pt: Então as nações temerão o nome do SENHOR; e todos os reis da terra temerão a tua glória;
verses.en_web: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name; all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.en_bbe: So the nations will give honour to the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth will be in fear of his glory:

verses.en: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.pt: Quando o SENHOR edificar a Sião, e aparecer em sua glória;
verses.en_web: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
verses.en_bbe: When the Lord has put up the walls of Zion, and has been been in his glory;

verses.en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.pt: E der atenção à oração do desamparado, e não desprezar sua oração.
verses.en_web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
verses.en_bbe: When he has given ear to the prayer of the poor, and has not put his request on one side.

verses.en: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
verses.pt: Isto será escrito para a geração futura; e o povo que for criado louvará ao SENHOR;
verses.en_web: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
verses.en_bbe: This will be put in writing for the coming generation, and the people of the future will give praise to the Lord.

verses.en: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
verses.pt: Porque ele olhará desde o alto de seu santuário; o SENHOR olhará desde os céus para a terra,
verses.en_web: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
verses.en_bbe: For from his holy place the Lord has seen, looking down on the earth from heaven;

verses.en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.pt: Para ouvir o gemido dos prisioneiros; para soltar aos sentenciados à morte.
verses.en_web: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
verses.en_bbe: Hearing the cry of the prisoner, making free those for whom death is ordered;

verses.en: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.pt: Para eles anunciarem o nome do SENHOR em Sião, e seu louvor em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.en_bbe: So that they may give out the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.en: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
verses.pt: Quando os povos se reunirem, e os reinos, para servirem ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: When the peoples are come together, and the kingdoms, to give worship to the Lord.

verses.en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.pt: Ele abateu minha força no caminho; abreviou os meus dias.
verses.en_web: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
verses.en_bbe: He has taken my strength from me in the way; he has made short my days.

verses.en: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.pt: Eu dizia: Meu Deus, não me leves no meio dos meus dias; teus anos são eternos,geração após geração.
verses.en_web: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.en_bbe: I will say, O my God, take me not away before my time; your years go on through all generations:

verses.en: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.pt: Desde muito antes fundaste a terra; e os céus são obra de tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.en_bbe: In the past you put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.en: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.pt: Eles se destruirão, porém tu permanecerás; e todos eles como vestimentas se envelhecerão; como roupas tu os mudarás, e serão mudados.
verses.en_web: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
verses.en_bbe: They will come to an end, but you will still go on; they all will become old like a coat, and like a robe they will be changed:

verses.en: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.pt: Porém tu és o mesmo; e teus anos nunca se acabarão.
verses.en_web: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
verses.en_bbe: But you are the unchanging One, and your years will have no end.

verses.en: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.pt: Os filhos de teus servos habitarão seguros,e a semente deles será firmada perante ti. Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”
verses.en_bbe: The children of your servants will have a safe resting-place, and their seed will be ever before you.
